summary: Frontend-only verification of Chapter 6 Pedagogical Noticing + homepage restructure + terminology cleanup. Homepage shows single Experience Compass panel with three stage cards (current/next/future) and single CTA linking to ?preview; no Teacher/Student split. Preview flow: welcome -> assignment -> writing works. After submit, preview-noticing appeared in 2.8s (well within 6s target) with understanding, recognition, and bridge beats populated with authentic grounded text (no teaching/corrections). preview-thinking-with cue visible while engine reasoned. Developmental preview-coaching-card appeared in 53.5s via polling; noticing block remained above it (DOM order confirmed: noticing_before_coaching). Terminology: no 'passage'/'essay' anywhere in learner-facing preview; placeholder is 'Your response…'; helper text 'Revise your response above, then send it back.' present; 'Your first draft' label present (rendered uppercase via CSS).
critical_code_review_comments: PublicPreview.jsx is ~720 lines with multiple sub-components (AssignmentScreen, WritingScreen, Thinking, ThinkingWith, NoticingBeats, Beat) inline — consider splitting each sub-component into its own file for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chapter 6 noticing UX verified end-to-end on live preview URL. Noticing endpoint responds ~3s; frozen engine coaching completes ~50-90s via polling. Both blocks coexist on-screen (continuous encounter). Ch6 acceptance fully met.
